THE SMALL PRINT.

How does it work?

Choose your coffees and support the café's funding goal. When it succeeds, your coffees become available. The café shares part of its sales as extra coffees for supporters.

This demo lets you skip ahead and try it. Nothing is purchased.

Why Rp37,500? What if the goal isn't reached?

Each coffee includes Rp25,000 set aside for your drink and Rp12,500 to help the café grow. You can request your money back if the funding goal isn't reached.

The money set aside doesn't guarantee the café will stay open or serve your drink.

What could I get as the café grows?

Your potential return is extra coffees, based on reported café sales and your original support. This version doesn't offer cash profit or company shares. The example below isn't a forecast.

For 4 coffees saved: 0.4 extra coffees

The café puts aside 10% of reported sales for supporters. Reports must arrive within 12 months of successful funding. Drinking your coffees doesn't reduce your share.

Can I turn my coffees into money?

Not in this version. Saved coffees are prepaid drinks; extra coffees are rewards from café sales. A rupiah coffee value tells you what those drinks cover, not what you can withdraw.

A possible future model would keep cash earnings separate: after the café funds your reward, you could withdraw it or convert it to coffee, once. This would need new contract terms, a payout service and legal review. It isn't available here.

Rewards depend on funded sales reports, not the café's valuation. Revenue is sales before expenses, not profit. No reward or return of your original support is guaranteed after successful funding.

Any other limits I should know?

Use whole coffees. Leftover portions may stay unusable when rewards end. You can't sell these coffees or exchange them for cash.

The service can pause access or suspend an account. Refunds for unsuccessful funding stay available. There is no café-closure refund process after successful funding in this prototype.

This is a practice version. A real launch needs agreed customer terms, verified café sales, and legal and security review.

For the curious: the technology

The planned service uses blockchain records to track coffees and prevent double use. This website is a simulation; it isn't connected to a blockchain.
